questions.question: Six boys Sumit, Gopal, Honey, Ishaan, Jatin and Lalit are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Ishaan is the third to the left of Sumit. Jatin and Honey are the immediate neighbours of Ishaan. Lalit is to the immediate right of Jatin. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Ishaan?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) Ishaan is third to the left of Sumit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/390e4c62cf07fe24d2ffdb5f876e1da6b7a5c9c4149a542df4956c6e12906b0e.png] 

2) Jatin and Honey are the immediate neighbours of Ishaan.

3) Lalit is to the immediate right of Jatin.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b4f90c25aabe0b154821ec2d93f08b156acd514c4b081a9bd93c4a3f8402ef9.png] 

Here, we can see that Honey is sitting to the immediate left of Ishaan.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

Here, we can see that Mark sits to the immediate right of Pam.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
On folding the given dice, which number will be opposite to the number '20'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e85861baf25ae46e72fe7205749485843ec8d8771bfdedd143599353efc5d66.png]
questions.solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below methods: -

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners.

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces: -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa3e97e36311bb1e157be05a1b9e2b89a560a43a531050f2b23791298902f633.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9171e30cf947293c59126800bdd18dcd3360893594bc0aed9ad7ef2b8422240e.png] 

Here, we can see that the number on the opposite side of '20' is '50'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"50"**.
